description: Spec 005 Gate S plan (T026): segmenters C and L, the references, L's training stream and the test seed. Generator 0.6.0 (MAN2). Fixed before any L training; the test digest is filled at generation (T028) by an amendment listed by digest.

validation.ordinals_of: sigma = 1 deg scenarios in file order (note 08)

test.scored: every sigma = 1 deg scenario of the test split with a G5 row; every G5 row of each

l_stream.tables: per-shard SHA-256 in each training run's results branch (tables.sha256)
l_stream.noise: one draw (the generated bearings); cost tables are computed once per scenario, so the per-epoch re-noise of spec 003 is not used

segmenter.glr_threshold_from: tuned on validation tuning ordinals 0-499 to nominator_far (results/segment-man2-val-c-41876210154); fixed for every later run, test included

training.validation_for_early_stopping: CRF loss on validation tuning ordinals 0-499
training.carried_rule: median of the three seeds by validation gap recovered (range) on scoring ordinals 500-1499
